app.title: TLOL4 Sports League Dashboard
app.tagline: One League. Many Sports. One Champion.
app.footer_text: Built with Streamlit • TLOL4 Sports League

rules: Team captains must confirm playing members before match start.
Umpire or organiser decision is final.
Late arrival may lead to walkover as per organiser discretion.
card_details: Win points, bonus points, and fair play points can be updated in the Participants sheet.
Use the Fixtures sheet Status column to mark Upcoming, Live, Completed, or Postponed.

rules: Standard singles format unless organisers communicate otherwise.
Players must report at the venue before the scheduled time.
Final score should be confirmed by both participants.
card_details: Fixture card shows participant, team, venue, match number, and status.
Participant points are merged across all sports on the leaderboard.

rules: No spinning rods unless organisers explicitly allow it.
First player or team to the agreed score wins.
Disputes should be escalated to the organiser immediately.
card_details: Use Match column for table or match number.
Use Venue column for table location or office zone.

rules: Players should follow standard carrom board rules agreed before the match.
Queen cover rule applies if organisers enable it for the round.
Winner and bonus points should be updated after result confirmation.
card_details: Each fixture card shows participant versus participant with team colors.
Completed fixtures remain visible under sport tabs for easy tracking.

rules: Highest score after the agreed number of frames wins.
Participants must follow venue safety instructions.
Tie-breaker rules should be decided by the organiser.
card_details: Use Match column for lane or match reference.
Use Status to separate upcoming and completed fixtures.

rules: Standard singles or doubles format as announced by organisers.
Line calls should be respected unless a referee is assigned.
Players must be ready at the court on time.
card_details: Cards support individual and team entries.
Use Participant 1 and Participant 2 for player names or team names.

rules: Serve rotation and game format should be agreed before the match.
Players must report scores after match completion.
Organiser decision is final for disputed calls.
card_details: Each tab automatically appears when the sport exists in the Fixtures sheet.
No code change is needed for adding new sports.
